answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the terrace log shows the live set and the willow audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 508 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 76 aliases alive therefore means 76 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the delta quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
